entries.title: Growing in Faith and Obedience
entries.reflection: God calls His people to hear His Word and obey it with sincerity.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to walk in Your truth.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival starts with a heart that seeks God rather than applause. Consider how this truth shapes your private decisions on 11/13; let this teaching guide your response to difficulty.
topics.prayer: Lord, invite God to renew your first love; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: A holy life grows through ordinary choices made in obedience. Examine your motives in the light of Scripture on 11/13; respond with patience instead of haste.
topics.prayer: Lord, reject what weakens your conscience; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is a refuge even when answers seem delayed. Respond with patience instead of haste on 11/13; act faithfully even without recognition.
topics.prayer: Lord, bring your uncertainty to Him; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer keeps our dependence on God active through the day. Make time for quiet reflection on this verse on 11/13; look for an opportunity to practise this truth.
topics.prayer: Lord, remember someone else in prayer; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Christ calls sinners to turn toward Him in repentance and faith. Ask how this Scripture should shape your words on 11/13; bring a neglected responsibility before God.
topics.prayer: Lord, respond honestly to His call; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust in God is shown when obedience costs us comfort. Let this teaching guide your response to difficulty on 11/13; ask how this Scripture should shape your words.
topics.prayer: Lord, take a faithful step today; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit strengthens believers for Christlike living and witness. Share encouragement rooted in this passage on 11/13; examine your motives in the light of Scripture.
topics.prayer: Lord, ask for courage to do right; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel is good news to be shared with compassion. Bring a neglected responsibility before God on 11/13; remember someone who needs your kindness.
topics.prayer: Lord, speak truth without harshness; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian unity requires patience and practical love. Let gratitude guide your next action on 11/13; end the day by reviewing your obedience.
topics.prayer: Lord, seek peace with another believer; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: The Word becomes fruitful when we put it into practice. End the day by reviewing your obedience on 11/13; share encouragement rooted in this passage.
topics.prayer: Lord, apply a clear teaching today; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God gives wisdom to those who ask in faith. Look for an opportunity to practise this truth on 11/13; make time for quiet reflection on this verse.
topics.prayer: Lord, seek counsel before deciding; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Watchfulness means living faithfully while awaiting Christ. Choose humility when your plans are interrupted on 11/13; consider how this truth shapes your private decisions.
topics.prayer: Lord, keep your responsibilities in order; guide my actions today.

topics.reflection: The Spirit strengthens believers for Christlike living and witness. Remember someone who needs your kindness on 01/12; let this teaching guide your response to difficulty.
topics.prayer: Lord, ask for courage to do right; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel is good news to be shared with compassion. Act faithfully even without recognition on 01/12; respond with patience instead of haste.
topics.prayer: Lord, speak truth without harshness; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian unity requires patience and practical love. Consider how this truth shapes your private decisions on 01/12; act faithfully even without recognition.
topics.prayer: Lord, seek peace with another believer; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: The Word becomes fruitful when we put it into practice. Examine your motives in the light of Scripture on 01/12; look for an opportunity to practise this truth.
topics.prayer: Lord, apply a clear teaching today; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God gives wisdom to those who ask in faith. Respond with patience instead of haste on 01/12; bring a neglected responsibility before God.
topics.prayer: Lord, seek counsel before deciding; guide my actions today.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Watchfulness means living faithfully while awaiting Christ. Make time for quiet reflection on this verse on 01/12; ask how this Scripture should shape your words.
topics.prayer: Lord, keep your responsibilities in order; guide my actions today.
